prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot, head to toe, five-material body (symmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult American woman in Instagram glam makeup — sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, long voluminous honey-blonde waves, a confident, camera-ready smile. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a gold hoop.

Physique: A towering giantess on an even scale at full head-to-toe height — massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full chest, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her legs vessel and vessel.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left leg (hip to foot): a sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear ice-blue water with drifting snowflakes, sealing shut at a matching glass sandal, the water continuing unbroken through the ankle and every toe. Right leg (hip to foot): a sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear ice-blue water with drifting snowflakes, sealing shut at a matching glass sandal, the water continuing unbroken through the ankle and every toe.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a bright cobalt blue on one side and a warm golden yellow on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so blue light glances off one side and yellow light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
